apps.name: WF Schedule
apps.subtitle: Your Whole Foods schedule on iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Sign in with your Whole Foods account to keep your schedule, breaks, widgets, and discount barcode on your iPhone.

• Day strip and agenda scroll together like a dial
• Shift color legend for Cash Office, Supervisor, and holiday pay
• Weather on Home for the city you work in
• Break timer and Live Activity
• Discount barcode for the register

versions.localizedDescription: Settings → Appearance now has six looks: Classic, Light, and Dark for Light Mode and again for Dark Mode. Classic keeps the mixed white header and dark agenda; Light is the all-white calendar; Dark is fully dark.
The job-color labels sit above the calendar handle instead of overlapping it.
The day strip and agenda scroll together like a dial. A small legend names Cash Office, Supervisor, holiday pay, and your other jobs, and the bars on each day use those colors.

Home shows weather for the city you work in. The selected-day bar matches your theme, with a second bar on shift days. Drag the white header to expand the month. Placeholder Design meetings and reviews are gone.
Redesigned Home calendar with a day ticker, month grid, and scrolling agenda. Removed the leftover bottom bar that showed through the glass tab bar.
Home Screen icons and settings tiles now match the selected color theme, including a new Rainbow icon.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: WF Schedule creates a dedicated 'Work Schedule' calendar and adds your shifts to it so they stay in sync with your other Apple devices.
privacy.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: WF Schedule rings an alarm when a break or lunch timer you started is over.
